headline: HSBC Rolls Out HKDAP Stablecoin to Everyday App Users
summary: HSBC has rolled out its first stablecoin to over 3 million everyday app users following regulatory licensing in Hong Kong.
why: HSBC Holdings is a major international banking group. The integration of stablecoins into retail banking apps marks a significant convergence of traditional finance and digital assets.

impacts.name: HSBC
impacts.why: Adopting blockchain-based stablecoins expands digital banking offerings and could increase fee-based transaction volumes.
